description: Readeck is a simple, self-hosted read-it-later app: save web pages and it keeps a clean, readable copy of the article — text, images and highlights — in your own archive, forever, with labels, collections, full-text search and e-book export.
name: Readeck
seoDescription: Deploy Readeck with Docker Compose on Dokploy — the self-hosted read-it-later and bookmark archiver that saves clean readable copies of web pages.
